canonical_storage.github_role: Versioned discovery universe reference, curated bibliographic metadata, artifact hashes, provenance, implementation state, and verification verdicts.
canonical_storage.huggingface_role: Large or frequently changing public source snapshots, normalized inputs, derived datasets, checkpoints, and evaluation artifacts.
canonical_storage.promotion_rule: An HF artifact is reusable evidence only after its exact SHA-256 and provenance are committed to this GitHub registry. A mutable bucket path alone is never canonical evidence.

papers.implementation_scope: Method-contract simplex projection plus an independent empirical reproduction of Section 3.2 Table 1, point-by-point direct formulation at beta=2.0. Other paper figures/tables remain outside this run scope.
papers.paper_claim: Deep neural-network formulations are proposed for Mean-Variance and Mean-CVaR efficient frontiers; a projected feedforward formulation is reported to handle global portfolio-weight constraints and outperform classical penalization in the paper's experiments.
papers.title: Deep learning for efficient frontier calculation in finance
papers.unreproduced_evidence: This run covers one locked Table 1 point only. Dimension-20, constrained, Heston, Mean-CVaR, global, and remaining point-by-point experiments are not claimed reproduced.

papers.implementation_scope: Deterministic implementation of the paper's stated invest-versus-cash reward contract, including entry transaction cost and cross-sectional mean cash reward. No DQN training.
papers.paper_claim: A Deep Q-learning portfolio method is evaluated out of sample on 48 US-stock portfolio setups from 10 to 500 stocks and is reported to outperform the considered passive and active benchmarks on average.
papers.title: High-Dimensional Stock Portfolio Trading with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's complete point-in-time stock universe, fundamentals, training states, validation checkpoint selection, and test trades have not yet been materialized into the canonical artifact store.

papers.implementation_scope: Deterministic multi-scale realized-variance feature construction with scale-consistency checks. No LSTM training or benchmark reproduction.
papers.paper_claim: A multi-scale LSTM using multiple currency-pair inputs is reported to outperform autoregressive, GARCH, and other deep-learning baselines for Forex volatility prediction.
papers.title: Forex Trading Volatility Prediction using Neural Network Models
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's Forex dataset, exact train/test tensors, fitted model weights, and baseline forecasts have not yet been materialized into the canonical artifact store.

papers.implementation_scope: Deterministic weighted multi-relation graph aggregation with row normalization. No Graph Transformer training or benchmark reproduction.
papers.paper_claim: A Graph Transformer Network is proposed to combine limit-order-book features with temporal and cross-sectional relations; experiments on about 500 S&P 500 stocks report better performance than the paper's benchmarks.
papers.title: Multivariate Realized Volatility Forecasting with Graph Neural Network
papers.unreproduced_evidence: The paper's limit-order-book dataset, relation tensors, training configuration, fitted model weights, and benchmark predictions have not yet been materialized into the canonical artifact store.

selection_note: Curated representative 2021 arXiv q-fin papers spanning portfolio optimization, reinforcement-learning trading, multi-currency volatility forecasting, and cross-sectional graph volatility forecasting. This is not a citation ranking.
